template: No foreign-ownership reservation or cap for this activity was located in Perpres 10/2021 as amended by Perpres 49/2021 (Lampiran I, II, III) or in its closed list — so this is not a national 0% finding. OSS currently publishes licensing rows for this code only at {scales} scale, while a PT PMA is by law an Usaha Besar that must invest more than IDR 10 billion per KBLI per location (Perpres 10/2021 Pasal 7(1); Permen Investasi/BKPM 5/2025 Pasal 26(1)–(2)): whether OSS will license this code for a PT PMA must be confirmed in OSS; a scale missing from the licensing rules does not by itself restrict the activity (Permen Investasi/BKPM 5/2025 Pasal 8(6)).{sector} In Bali we flag this code as blocked as a precaution, not because a closure naming it was located. The Governor of Bali asked BKPM (letter B.27.000/642/PM/DPMPTSP, 28 Jan 2026) to close OSS to PT PMA in the Rendah and Menengah Rendah risk tiers, which include this code ({tier}). The provincial government reports that the closure applied from the third week of May 2026 covers 18 listed KBLI, and under the official BPS KBLI 2020→2025 crosswalk this code is not among them. Confirm the current OSS status in Bali before relying on this flag either way.

38110.sector: The only waste-sector Lampiran II row (38302) is a partnership (kemitraan) row, which does not bar a PT PMA.
38110.expected_reason: No foreign-ownership restriction located in Perpres 49/2021 Lampiran I/II/III, the closed list, or any sectoral instrument read — so this is NOT closed to foreign ownership. It is blocked in Bali by the PMA moratorium: risk tier ['Menengah Rendah'] falls inside the Rendah / Menengah Rendah categories the Governor of Bali asked BKPM to close on OSS (letter B.27.000/642/PM/DPMPTSP, 28 Jan 2026, read at source: the request is by RISK TIER, and carries no annex or code list).

56102.sector: The applicable tourism standard (Permenpar 6/2025) sets a Sertifikat Standar and hygiene requirement with no scale gating, and for food and beverage services the PMA investment threshold is counted per 2-digit KBLI per regency/city (Permen Investasi/BKPM 5/2025 Pasal 26).
56102.expected_reason: The located requirement is not an ownership rule and a PT PMA can satisfy it: Permenpar 6/2025 Lampiran, standards for 56103/56104/56109 — Sertifikat Standar + hygiene (HSP/SLHS). No 56xxx entry anywhere in Perpres 49/2021 — so this is NOT closed to foreign ownership. It is blocked in Bali by the PMA moratorium: risk tier ['Menengah Rendah'] falls inside the Rendah / Menengah Rendah categories the Governor of Bali asked BKPM to close on OSS (letter B.27.000/642/PM/DPMPTSP, 28 Jan 2026, read at source: the request is by RISK TIER, and carries no annex or code list).
